title: artemisia campestris subsp. borealis
intro: Artemisia campestris subsp. borealis, commonly known as Boreal Sagebrush, is a subspecies of the Artemisia campestris plant, belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions such as digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Boreal Sagebrush are primarily attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit adaptogenic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
